title: Christmas Planner Stickers & Washi Tape
author: Iris Art Studios
description:
Christmas planner stickers, washi tape
Printable Stickers, Planner Stickers, Instant Download, Bullet Journal,  Decorative Stickers, Scrapbook Stickers, Cricut Cut File, Print and Cut, Cricut Project
♥ All elements are hand drawn by me
♥ This PRINTABLE sticker sheet contains high quality images that look fabulous printed and cut. It comes as a digital download JPG, PDF and transparent PNG format files. Those stickers are perfect for use in your digital planners, notebooks, calendars and more! You can also print these out and cut  them with the help of a cutting machine or some scissors.
